roles.title: Accordion
roles.description: Vertically stacked sections, each with a header that reveals or hides content below it.

roles.title: Action Sheet
roles.description: Modal sheet sliding up from the bottom presenting a list of contextual actions.

roles.title: Alert
roles.description: Inline message communicating a status — informational, success, warning, or error.

roles.title: Avatar
roles.description: Circular or rounded image representing a person or entity.

roles.title: Badge
roles.description: Small count or status label overlaid on or beside another element.

roles.title: Banner
roles.description: Prominent strip promoting content, a sale, or an announcement.

roles.title: Breadcrumb
roles.description: Horizontal trail showing the current page's location in the site or app hierarchy.

roles.title: Button
roles.description: Tappable element that triggers an action.

roles.title: Card
roles.description: Contained surface grouping related content and optional actions.

roles.title: Carousel
roles.description: Horizontally scrollable series of cards or images, showing one or a few items at a time.

roles.title: Checkbox
roles.description: Binary selection control for toggling an option on or off.

roles.title: Chip
roles.description: Compact tag used for filtering, selection, or labelling.

roles.title: Color Picker
roles.description: Control for selecting a color from a palette or spectrum.

roles.title: Combobox
roles.description: Text input combined with a filterable dropdown list of suggestions.

roles.title: Command Palette
roles.description: Full-screen overlay with a search input for quickly finding and triggering commands or navigation.

roles.title: Context Menu
roles.description: Floating list of actions anchored to a specific element or tap position.

roles.title: Date Picker
roles.description: Control for selecting a date, or date range, from a calendar view.

roles.title: Dialog
roles.description: Modal overlay requiring user interaction before returning to the main flow.

roles.title: Divider
roles.description: Horizontal or vertical line used to separate sections of content.

roles.title: Drawer
roles.description: Panel that slides in from a screen edge, overlaying content without replacing it.

roles.title: Dropdown Menu
roles.description: Floating list of options anchored to a trigger, for navigation or actions.

roles.title: Empty State
roles.description: Placeholder shown when a list or view has no content, guiding the user to an action.

roles.title: File Uploader
roles.description: Area for selecting or dropping files for upload.

roles.title: Floating Action Button
roles.description: Circular button fixed above content, representing the primary action on a screen.

roles.title: Full Screen Overlay
roles.description: A view that occupies the entire screen, typically presented modally over another screen.

roles.title: Gallery
roles.description: Grid of images or media thumbnails displayed in a uniform tiled layout.

roles.title: Hyperlink
roles.description: Inline text that navigates to another location when activated.

roles.title: Item Indicator
roles.description: Row of dots or marks showing position within an ordered set of items — slides, steps, pages, or images.

roles.title: Launch Screen
roles.description: Full-screen view shown while an app is loading, typically displaying a logo or brand mark.

roles.title: Loading Indicator
roles.description: Visual cue that an operation is in progress.

roles.title: Navigation Menu
roles.description: A set of links or destinations used to move between sections of an app or site.

roles.title: Pagination
roles.description: Numbered page controls for navigating through a multi-page dataset.

roles.title: Popover
roles.description: Small floating panel anchored to a trigger element, for supplementary information or a compact form.

roles.title: Progress Indicator
roles.description: Bar or ring showing how much of a process has completed.

roles.title: Radio Button
roles.description: Single-selection control where only one option from a group can be chosen.

roles.title: Search Bar
roles.description: Input field dedicated to searching or filtering content.

roles.title: Segmented Control
roles.description: A set of mutually exclusive options displayed as connected segments, one selected at a time.

roles.title: Select
roles.description: A control that shows a single chosen value and opens a list for changing it.

roles.title: Sidebar
roles.description: Persistent vertical panel on the side of the screen containing navigation or contextual tools.

roles.title: Skeleton
roles.description: Placeholder shapes shown while content is loading, matching the rough layout of the expected content.

roles.title: Slider
roles.description: A track with a draggable thumb for selecting a value within a continuous range.

roles.title: Stepper
roles.description: A control with increment and decrement buttons for adjusting a numeric value.

roles.title: Switch
roles.description: Toggle control that switches a setting between on and off.

roles.title: Tab Bar
roles.description: Row of tabs for switching between top-level sections of an app.

roles.title: Table
roles.description: Grid of rows and columns presenting structured data.

roles.title: Text Area
roles.description: Multi-line text input for longer freeform content.

roles.title: Text Field
roles.description: Single-line input for entering short text values.

roles.title: Time Picker
roles.description: Control for selecting a time value.

roles.title: Toast
roles.description: Brief notification that appears temporarily, typically at the bottom of the screen.

roles.title: Toolbar
roles.description: A horizontal row of action controls contextually relevant to selected content or the current view.

roles.title: Tooltip
roles.description: Small label that appears on hover or long-press to explain a control or provide context.

roles.title: Top Navigation Bar
roles.description: Persistent bar at the top of a screen showing the title and primary actions.

roles.title: Tree
roles.description: Hierarchical list of expandable and collapsible nodes representing nested content.
